row.body: A store key is tied to a note about a hidden supply bundle; the delivery was logged before the crew’s field date, and no one signed for it.
row.title: Hidden delivery

sidecar.gloss: A hidden bundle is logged before its listed field use.
sidecar.rival_reading: Emergency storage could explain a hidden bundle and early delivery; the blank signature does not identify the supplies’ purpose.

row.body: the sewing needle and clipboard carry the same black paint. a fresh scrape exposes an older evacuation color beneath.
row.title: missing count beside the sewing needle

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
